name: certidemy-anchor
description: ISOLATED ON PURPOSE. opentimestamps pulls request@2.88.2, deprecated since 2020, carrying an unpatchable SSRF advisory plus qs/tough-cookie/uuid issues. Keeping it in its own package.json means the main supabase tree stays at zero vulnerabilities and nothing else can import it. Runs only on a GitHub Actions runner - a disposable Ubuntu container with no internal endpoints for an SSRF to reach.
